contexts.text: In the interior man conscience has been implanted.
Goods... and truths... have been implanted in his conscience; and as they have been implanted through faith...
Knowledges, which ought to be implanted in the celestial things bestowed from infancy.
Truths and goods are implanted by means of Knowledges in his celestial things...
As the Lord has implanted Knowledges in his celestial things, so he has perception. Signified.
The conjunction of men with the Lord is effected through... the implantation of faith into love. Unless faith is implanted in love...
In their place, truths and goods... are implanted. Representation.
Knowledges, which... are implanted in the memory.
Charity was implanted by means of truth.
Celestial... and spiritual things... are not simultaneously but successively implanted in them by the Lord...
That by His Own power the Lord had implanted the Human in the Divine. Signified.
To suckle = to implant it.
Which affections (of truth and good) are wonderfully implanted by the Lord in the truths of the prior Rational.
He gave it to Hagar = implantation in its life.
With those who are becoming spiritual, good and truth are implanted by the Lord in the affection of knowledges...
In the goods and truths to be afterwards implanted by the Lord.
With the celestial, good itself has been implanted in their voluntary part... But with the spiritual... good is implanted by the Lord in their intellectual part. AC 2718.
The quality of good is according to the state of innocence, love, and charity in which the truths of faith have been implanted or can be implanted.

In the same proportion (charity and love) are implanted in the Natural of man, in which they are as in their soil. They are first implanted there by means of instruction... afterwards from one's Own reflection, but are thereby only stored up in the natural memory... But in proportion as the man comes into the affection of truth from life, they are implanted in His Natural as in their soil. The things which are not implanted thus are indeed with the man, but only in his memory...
(Thus) all the implantation of truth... is effected by means of affection.
But truths cannot be implanted and conjoined with good, except by means of the affections of truth and good.
(Thus) no truth can ever be implanted with genuine affection, and rooted interiorly, unless the man is in good...
So long as (doctrinal things)... are not yet implanted in the spiritual... man. Signified.
(Thus) the objects of the external sight are implanted according to the... delight of the affections.
Thus good is that in which truths are inseminated and implanted.
The truth which has been implanted and inrooted in the interiors of man has been implanted and inrooted by means of affection...
These two faculties are to be conjoined... by means of the implantation of truth... in good...
Good... and truth... which are to be implanted. Signified.
To sow = to implant.
But when truth and good have been implanted, ground no longer = a receptacle, but that which is of the Church.
Before Knowledges... can be implanted in good... there is pain. Signified.
Thus (by temptations) the truths... and goods... are more interiorly implanted...
The consequent implantation and confirmation of truth from good. Treated of.
The internal things of worship... must be implanted in freedom... The things which are implanted in compulsion remain... in the external man.
Faith could never be implanted in those of the Spiritual Church except by means of temptations; thus neither could charity.
In proportion as the external man is reduced to obedience under the internal, faith and charity are implanted.
(Regeneration) is effected by the implantation of faith and charity...
Because, by means of temptations, truths and goods are implanted.
All are perfected by means of the implantation of faith and charity in the external... man; for, unless these are implanted there, good and truth cannot inflow...
The good of truth... is implanted in the intellectual part...
The state of good in which the truths of faith are to be implanted. Signified. AC 8754, Explained.

For truths cannot be implanted until he is in good. They are indeed known before, because they are in the memory... Afterwards, when the man receives new life... the truths of faith are implanted... This good, in which the truths of faith have not as yet been implanted, is here meant by the wilderness of Sinai.

(The state) when they are in the good in which the truths of faith are to be implanted, (is) an intermediate state... The truths which are being implanted in good are contained in the things which were promulgated from Sinai.
They are not in any Conjugial until the truth with them has been implanted in good...
It treats in this chapter of the good into which truth has not as yet been implanted; and, in the following ones, of its implantation.
It treats in this chapter of the truths Divine which are to be implanted in the good with those of the Spiritual Church.
The seventh day is the Sabbath... = good implanted, and thus a marriage.
Thus is good implanted through truths...
As soon as the good of love has been implanted, combat ceases...

Temptations conduce to confirm the truths of faith, and also to implant them, and to insinuate them into the will... For the man... fights from the truths of faith... and... when he conquers, he confirms himself in them, and implants them.
That then are implanted the truths of doctrine and the goods of life. Treated of.
The feast of harvest = the implantation of truth in good; and the feast of ingathering, the implantation of the good thence... AC 9294:2.
Worship of the Lord and thanksgiving on account of the implantation of truth in good. Signified.
Harvest = the fructification of truth; thus the implantation of it in good.
But the truths which are being inseminated are to be implanted in good, because they have no ground elsewhere... They are implanted in good when the man wills truth...
When truths have been implanted in good, man... is led by good...
The plenary implantation of truth in good even to the first of a new state. Signified.
Worship from a grateful lower mind on account of the implantation of good thence... Signified.
What the implantation of good is. Explained.
When a man is being regenerated, which is effected through the implantation of spiritual truth and good...
In proportion as goods and truths have been implanted in their order, and interiorly.
That regeneration, or the implantation of the life of Heaven with man, begins from his infancy, and lasts... to eternity. References.
Because, by means of a successive implantation, goods and truths must remove (evils and falsities).
When man is being regenerated, he is conceived anew, born, becomes an infant, grows up; which is effected by means of truth implanted in good...
In proportion as a man is purified from evils and falsities, the truths of faith are implanted...
The implantation of good by the Lord, and the reception of it... Signified.

In both Kingdoms, good is implanted by means of truth; but with those who are in the Spiritual Kingdom, good is implanted by means of truth in the intellectual part; whereas with those in the Celestial Kingdom, good is implanted by means of truth in the voluntary part. The implantation of good by means of truth with those in the Spiritual Kingdom is effected in a different manner than with those in the Celestial Kingdom; with (the former), truth is implanted in the external... man, and there first becomes knowledge... Whereas with (the latter), truth does not become knowledge...
To propitiate... therefore involves the implantation of good and truth... because in proportion as a man is purified from evils and falsities, good and truth are implanted...
The implantation of truth and good by the Lord is the reception of Him, thus sanctification.
To infill the hand = to implant good and truth...
The implantation of good and truth is to think and will good and truth, and to speak and do them...
As to the implantation of truth in good, and its reception. Signified.
The reason ploughing = the implantation of truth in good, is...
As man is in equilibrium... good can be implanted in him...
The good which man receives in freedom is implanted in his will...
Innocence is such that all things of Heaven can be implanted in it...
To implant in an infant or child the idea of three Divine Persons...
In the place (of concupiscences) are implanted affections of good and truth...
Then the Lord implants in his midst charity and faith, and makes both spiritual.
The implantation of Divine truth by the Lord. Signified, Explained.

The regeneration of (the Celestial Church) is effected by the Lord by means of the implantation of celestial good; afterwards, by means of the implantation of spiritual good, which in its essence is the truth of celestial good...
